streams.reasoning: Chemistry Plan specifies single stream mixing all reagents. Concentration matches batch (0.3 M). Flow rate derived from calculation to achieve target residence time.

mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan states all reagents dissolved together in DMF before heating. Single stream implies no pre-reactor mixing required, but T-mixer used if splitting for pressure/flow control, otherwise direct feed.
pre_reactor_steps: Dissolve 4-Fluoronitrobenzene and piperazine in DMF to 0.3 M concentration.
post_reactor_steps: Standard aqueous workup as per batch protocol.
chemistry_notes: SnAr reaction of 4-fluoronitrobenzene with piperazine in DMF. Thermal reaction at 120 C. No light source required. No deoxygenation required as reaction is robust to air. Single stream feed simplifies setup. Residence time reduced from 6h (batch) to 36 min (flow) based on kinetic intensification factor of 10x.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Calculation Step 2 estimated 36.0 min based on 10x intensification factor for kinetic control. Analogy 2 used 30 min for similar SnAr at higher T; 36 min is conservative and within calculated range [24-154 min].
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Single phase liquid system. Basis is liquid volume / liquid flow.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Same as batch (120 C) per Chemistry Plan. Analogy 1 and 2 used higher T (250/220 C) but our substrate/solvent system is stable at 120 C and batch yield is good.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8 states BPR not required. DMF bp (153 C) > T (120 C) + 20 C margin. No gas generated.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA selected for thermal stability at 120 C and chemical resistance to DMF. FEP is also acceptable but PFA has higher temp rating. SS not required as no corrosion issues identified.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: 0.3 M matches batch concentration per Chemistry Plan. Analogy 1 used 0.5 M, but maintaining batch concentration ensures comparable kinetics and solubility.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Derived from V = Q * t. Q = 18.0 mL / 36.0 min = 0.5 mL/min. Matches Calculation Step 3.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: 18.0 mL from Calculation Step 3. Consistent with Analogy 1 (10 mL) and Analogy 2 (16.4 mL) scale.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: 1.0 mm from Calculation Step 3. Provides laminar flow (Re=11) and good heat transfer.
reasoning_per_field.light_setup: Thermal reaction, no light required per Chemistry Plan.
reasoning_per_field.deoxygenation_method: None required per Chemistry Plan (air atmosphere acceptable).
